reviews.text: I have two dogs who are both always happy to go to the vet. Personally, I think they provide good service. They are quick and take you seriously.

Unfortunately, a very disappointing experience at Caressa.

I had an appointment for my dog ​​Lola's vaccination. Although I understand that emergencies should always take priority, the consultation was interrupted almost immediately due to an emergency. As a result, the actual consultation lasted less than three minutes.

My objection is not directed at the fact that an emergency was given priority, but at the fact that the full consultation fee was subsequently charged. In my opinion, this amount is completely disproportionate to the service actually provided. Moreover, the cost of the consultation was even higher than the cost of the vaccination itself.

What disappoints me most is that, despite acknowledging the exceptional circumstances, the practice showed no willingness whatsoever to reconsider the invoice or offer any compensation. Instead, it was simply stated that the full consultation costs remain due, regardless of the very limited duration of the consultation.

Good animal care requires not only medical expertise but also reasonableness and customer focus. It is precisely these last two that I missed in this situation.

For that reason, I am unfortunately unable to recommend this practice.
Very sweet employees who have their hearts in the right place

Was very happy with the assistant who removed a tick from Loetje. She was very sweet and patient!

I've been a reasonably satisfied customer for almost 15 years. Unfortunately, I've recently noticed a lack of empathy within the practice.

A few weeks ago, I had to put my elderly dog ​​to sleep. Within five minutes of this emotional moment, the ATM was ready to pay the bill. As a stranger passing by, I might have understood this, but after so many years as a regular customer, it felt very cold and impersonal.

Furthermore, I was recently late for an appointment due to unforeseen circumstances. I politely called to explain and let them know I was on my way. Nevertheless, they sent me a hefty bill without hesitation, and I had to reschedule.

I find this very disappointing. The veterinarians themselves are generally friendly and helpful, but the company's mentality has made me decide to look for another vet.

The 2 stars are exclusively for the veterinarians working at this location; they deserve the full 5, but the company doesn't.

I called six times throughout the day yesterday, Tuesday, to schedule an appointment. I was on hold for ages. You couldn't schedule a neuter appointment online; they said I had to call, but I couldn't get through.
I now have an appointment elsewhere.

I rarely leave negative reviews, but my experience with Caressa76 was unacceptable on multiple levels. I am moving abroad with my cat and clearly communicated my strict travel timeline to the clinic in advance. Last week, on Tuesday, I brought my cat in for a rabies antibody (titer) test. At no point was I informed that results could take weeks, nor that official paperwork could take even longer. Only after the blood was drawn and after paying nearly €400 did they inform me it could take 2–3 weeks for results plus another week for documentation - making it impossible for me to travel as planned.

Had they been transparent, I would have gone to another clinic. Instead, they proceeded with a service they knew they could not deliver in time, and took my money anyway. This feels intentionally misleading.

To make things worse, the staff has shown a lack of professionalism and empathy throughout this process. Emails went unanswered, calls were constantly bounced between assistants, and instead of de-escalating and helping, I was met with attitude and dismissiveness. I was even called “Mr” over the phone despite my name being Anne and them having my details in their system - which was just odd?

Additionally, during the appointment, I was in the room when they attempted to take blood from my cat’s jugular vein. They poked her multiple times, failed, and ultimately had to sedate her - something I was charged extra for. My cat is extremely calm and sweet, and I’ve never seen her treated so incompetently.

I am now facing massive disruptions to my international move, unexpected extra housing costs, and delays to medical procedures abroad - all because this clinic failed to provide accurate information, basic communication, or professional care.

If you depend on timely, transparent, or compassionate service — particularly for international travel - I strongly advise going elsewhere!

Looking forward to your reply regarding my refund, thank you!

UPDATE:
Serious Errors and Unprofessional Handling!

I am posting this review because what happened deserves to be documented, especially for anyone relying on this clinic for legally required international pet travel paperwork.

After weeks of communication about the strict travel timeline and requirements, I finally received an email from the clinic stating that the rabies titer certificate had arrived earlier than expected. They presented this as an exceptional effort and asked me to reconsider or remove a negative review because of it.

Following their written instructions to “bring the passport and collect the certificate,” I went to the clinic to finalize the process. However, when I took the document to the NVWA for legalization, I was informed the certificate had been issued with the wrong examination date - using an older date rather than the legally required timeframe for my travel.

Because of this preventable error:
- NVWA could not validate the document
- The certificate became unusable
- And the travel process could not be completed

Only after this failure occurred did the clinic tell me that correcting the document required a full new physical examination and that altering the date without seeing the animal would be considered fraud.

This critical legal requirement was never disclosed prior to issuing the document and directly contradicts the instructions they provided.

It is also important to note that despite initially telling me the lab could not expedite results, the results were ultimately fast-tracked - but only after escalation - and followed immediately by the request to remove or revise my review.

Beyond the logistical failure, the process involved:
- Significant emotional stress
- Time lost traveling back and forth
- Preventable disruption to planned travel
- And unnecessary mental strain in an already time-sensitive situation

All of this was avoidable had the clinic provided accurate information and handled the documentation correctly!

It was a preventable administrative error supported by incomplete or incorrect communication at critical points!

They also said they didn’t know which vet will do the appointment, but today they canceled saying that the vet I was was assigned to was sick. Cero help, just “no”

For the past year, I’ve been bringing my dogs to this clinic. Recently, I’ve noticed a decline in the quality of service, and I wonder if there has been a change in management. When my dog injured her leg, I called twice to schedule an appointment. However, despite her previous visit just a week ago, where she received a spray and painkillers, I encountered difficulties. I wanted to combine her follow-up appointment with her annual vaccinations to streamline costs, but I was informed it wasn’t possible due to their busy schedule. I requested the first available slot, only to be told I couldn’t until I was absolutely certain about bringing my dog in. This left me feeling frustrated—why would I inquire otherwise? Interestingly, during the appointment booking, the lady didn’t even ask for my details.

In the end, I sought out a different vet recommended by a friend. When I called to cancel my original appointment, they finally asked for my information. Additionally, I requested my dog’s records to be emailed to the new vet, and surprisingly, they agreed without inquiring about the new vet’s details. Unfortunately, this lack of intention to assist is concerning. If you’re facing an emergency, I recommend seeking help elsewhere, as this clinic’s unhelpful and unfriendly demeanor feels incongruent with the service you’re paying for.
